kind: optional native dependency source repair; no runtime binary overwritten

upstream_status.state: local proposal only; no upstream PR

root_cause: stopNpuProfiler releases the GIL. PythonTracer::stop acquires it only within its own scope. PythonTracer::clear subsequently destroys ThreadLocalResult objects with Py_DECREF, without holding the GIL. CPython 3.12 pymalloc requires the current thread state when freeing TraceContext.
repair: Acquire the GIL across PythonTracer::clear, including its context destruction. Do not remove stack, modules, shapes or release-GIL sections of stop/finalize.

deployment.collector_preflight: CPU-only isolated child with the same interpreter before opt bench serve; failure exits 3 and retains diagnostic data

apply: Rebuild the point-pinned dependency in a separate directory; do not treat source patching as binary deployment.
Run tools/check_comm_profiler_stop.py with the rebuilt library selected before requesting a new device window.
rollback: Remove the optional rebuilt-library environment prefix; the installed dependency remains untouched.
delete_when: A newer point-pinned torch_npu has an equivalent GIL repair and passes isolated stop/finalize regression.
verification_scope: Native isolated regression compiles the original TraceContext/ThreadLocalResult declarations and clear body, with unrelated state containers replaced by inert vectors. It is not a full dependency rebuild or dual-rank trace validation.
